title: Cabin Space and Noise
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly mention a roomy cabin and interior quietness, but many sampled fragments are too brief or loosely tied to cabin themes to support a clear sentiment classification.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the cabin as spacious, roomy, calm, and satisfying in overall comfort.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention cabin noise, a redesigned cabin, temperature syncing, and unrelated charging or idle-noise comments, but the sample is insufficiently consistent to summarize as a clear sentiment theme.

limitations: The undetermined set mixes cabin space, cabin noise, HVAC behavior, and at least one unrelated charging comment, so the topic cluster is not fully coherent.
